sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Each time something was seen, as a tile: a square crop of its frame around what was found, how sure the finder was, and what it is, where and when; a short preview while the pointer rests on it, and a press that takes the player there.

anatomy.container: A grid of equal columns (parts' Columns, fill), as many as fit with no tile narrower than min, 8 apart.
anatomy.tile: A column 6 apart, padded 4, rounded by radius-surface: the crop, then the name line, then the place line.
anatomy.crop: Square, on terminal, rounded by radius-control: the frame scaled and placed so the square around the box (1.4 times its larger side, centered on it, kept inside the frame) fills it; the whole image without a box. With alert: ringed 2 wide in critical.
anatomy.confidence: Over the crop's top end, 4 in: the confidence at text.2xs 500 in terminal-foreground on terminal/75, padded 4 across, rounded by radius-mini.
anatomy.preview: With a preview: its clip over the crop, covering it, shown and played muted while the pointer rests on the tile.
anatomy.name: A dot 6 across in its affiliation's track color (primary without one), then the label (or the id) at text.xs 500, cut with an ellipsis.
anatomy.place: The place and the time apart by a middle dot, at text.2xs in muted-foreground, cut with an ellipsis.

sightings.does: Each sighting: its id, label, affiliation, place, time, frame and box, confidence, preview and alert.

onSelect.does: Makes each tile a button that picks its sighting.

format.does: Writes a confidence; a whole percent by default.

min.does: The narrowest a tile gets: 7.5, 10 or 14rem.

hover.means: The pointer over a tile: washed when it is a button, and its preview playing.

selected.means: The sighting chosen: on primary at 10 percent, ringed 1 wide in primary.

alert.means: A sighting that calls for a look: its crop ringed in critical.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a tile: the focus ring around it.

keyboard.does: Reaches each tile in turn when the gallery picks.

appText.when: When it was seen, as the app writes it.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
